name: Member's Mark Boneless Skinless Chicken Tenderloins (Frozen 6 lb)
whyItWorks: Tenderloins are the naturally most tender cut of the chicken breast, cooking quickly without toughening. Free of marinades, breading, or additives, making them an ideal flare-safe staple.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Poach in lightly salted water or bake in foil. Shred or dice over warm white rice or rice noodles.
